source_scope: implementation, tests, package metadata, locks and shared command/configuration inputs; generated files and verification documents excluded
limitations: Full standard-scale performance workloads were not rerun; historical measurements retain their original source revisions.
Advisory coverage is the locked runtime dependency set applicable to CPython 3.14.8/Linux, using PyPI advisories at execution time; it excludes development tools and unknown vulnerabilities.
Browser checks are bounded functional, automated accessibility, and visual checks, not complete accessibility conformance or deployment security certification.
Hosted CI is a separate observation; local verification is not a hosted CI pass.

meridian.scope: working-tree journal and account screens, matching committed implementation

resonance.scope: working-tree seeded report, matching committed report template

reproduction: uv run --locked --project tooling/quality --python VERSION pytest scripts/tests
